title: universal-harness
subtitle: Your AI Tools, Everywhere — USB, Desktop & Android
summary: Your AI coding tools, everywhere: one portable runtime that runs from a USB drive or desktop with zero installs, controlled securely from your phone over the local network.
bullets: Runs AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Gemini CLI from a USB drive — nothing installed on the host
Dual-mode Android app: remote-control your desktop session, or run the whole runtime on the phone
Every connection between devices is encrypted end to end
